He added when the gelding gave ground to be out of contention, he eased it down over the final 100m. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be slow to recover. Stwds to  follow up on the post-race condition.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the gelding travelled satisfactorily behind the leaders, however gave no response to his riding from the 500m and when out of contention he eased it down in the straight, and the only explanation he could offer was the gelding was not able to perform to his best due to the quick back up & the hot conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be displaying a slow recovery. Tnr rep stated whilst the gelding had pleased the stable leading into the race it was apparent it did not back up & raced flat. Tnr rep since reported the gelding pulled up well & sent for a spell.
